purpose: Teach: 遊べる/ビリ/チャリ/脇役/最上/名残/グマ/少なめ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、放課後、皆と遊べる時間、減ったね。
lines.en: Riku, we don't have as much time to hang out after school anymore, do we?
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. A small note of loss underneath the casual tone. Pause before his name—like she's checking if it's okay to bring this up.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。徒競走、俺、ビリ、結構あったよ。
lines.en: Yeah. I come in last in races pretty often, actually.
lines.style: Dry, self-deprecating laugh tucked in. Not fishing for reassurance. Matter-of-fact acceptance with the smallest edge of humor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: チャリ、新しいの、買ってもらった!
lines.style: Bright, immediate enthusiasm. Bounces slightly in delivery. The kind of announcement that expects and invites response—genuine brightness, not forced.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 劇、お前、いつも脇役、上手いよな。
lines.en: You're always good at the smaller roles in plays, aren't you?
lines.style: Straightforward appreciation. Calm, genuine—not overstating. The tone of someone noticing something real and saying it plainly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、最上階の部屋、皆で集まったね。
lines.en: That school trip—remember when we all crowded into that room on the top floor?
lines.style: Warm recollection, almost nostalgic even in the present tense. Slight rise on the memory. Inviting him to share the moment with her again.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 青春の名残、感じる時、あるよな、最近。
lines.en: Sometimes lately I feel like… like the days are already slipping away, you know?
lines.style: Quiet, introspective. Searching for the right words—a pause or breath between phrases. Honest vulnerability. Not dramatic, just truthful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 動物のドキュメンタリー、アライグマ、可愛かった!
lines.en: There was this animal documentary—about raccoons—they were so cute!
lines.style: Genuine delight, lighter again. Quick energy. Speaking like she wants to share something that made her happy, not performing the happiness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お弁当、少なめに、頼んでみたよ、今日は。
lines.en: I ordered a smaller lunch box today.
lines.style: Casual, understated close. No emphasis. The kind of small thing someone mentions in passing, almost to themselves. Quiet and settled.
